## Laptop check-in
The fleet agent sends `POST /webhook/fleet/checkin` on boot, logon, wake, shutdown and every 5 minutes.

1. Create a **Header Auth** credential: name `X-Fleet-Token`, value = a long random secret. Select it on **Check-in webhook**.
2. Activate the workflow.

A check-in counts as **came online** when the laptop is new, was offline, was silent for more than 15 minutes, or just booted. Each session change goes to `fleet_events`. To send an alert, connect a Slack or email node after **Log event** and filter on `event = online`.
